subject.title: fix: suspension and restart wait for background execs

question: Should this protected PR remain blocked until exact-head automated validation and a real host suspension or restart run are posted?
rationale: The implementation appears correct, but the cited validation predates the fix and the external-PR proof gate requires observed after-fix behavior unless a maintainer explicitly overrides it.

options.title: Require exact-head real proof

options.title: Override the live-proof gate
